welcome: ✎ A short hello from both of you, one or two sentences. For example: thank you for being here, and an invitation to tap the photos on the table to hear the stories behind them.
closing: ✎ A thank-you note to your guests, two or three sentences: who helped you get here, and what today means to you.

mission.prize: ✎ What everyone who finds all 8 photos gets, e.g. a souvenir from our travels
mission.claim: ✎ How to claim it, e.g. Show this screen to our bridesmaid at the guestbook table

stories.title: How We Met
stories.caption: ✎ Where and when, e.g. a friend's birthday dinner, 2017

photo.alt: ✎ Describe the photo in one sentence for guests who use a screen reader

body: ✎ Where were you both the first time your paths crossed? Set the scene in two or three sentences: the place, the year, and what brought each of you there.
✎ What was your first impression of each other, and how right (or wrong) did it turn out to be?
